phases.name: Origination
phases.job: Find the target before it comes to market, and know why it is going to move. The work is surveillance and pattern recognition across public signals, not analysis of a company that has already hired a banker.

techniques.name: Deal Signal Monitoring
techniques.blurb: Automated surveillance for M&A triggers: Gazette filings, Companies House changes, credit movements and sector transaction activity.

techniques.name: Predictive Deal Origination
techniques.blurb: Score which companies are most likely to transact from financial stress indicators, ownership-change signals and sector consolidation patterns.

techniques.name: Data Subscription Rationalisation
techniques.blurb: Usage-log analysis across the firm's own data estate to find underused subscriptions and quantify the saving.

phases.name: Commercial diligence
phases.job: Form a view with no internal data. Everything here is bought or observed, so the discipline is knowing what each source is worth — and being explicit about the questions outside data cannot reach.

techniques.name: Alt Data Triangulation
techniques.blurb: Eleven subscriptions and 23 signals tested against seven claims from the IM. Four challenged, one untestable, and a growth claim worth £70m of enterprise value.

techniques.name: Trade Area & Footfall
techniques.blurb: Mobile-device footfall and Experian purchase data to size catchments, test demographic fit, measure competitive density and quantify cannibalisation between sites.

techniques.name: Telecoms: the Starlink Threat
techniques.blurb: Satellite broadband as a structural threat to fixed-line and rural fibre economics. Coverage overlap, addressable-base erosion and payback under displacement.

techniques.name: Churn Analysis
techniques.blurb: Cohort retention curves, survival modelling, lifetime value and revenue stress-testing under attrition scenarios.

techniques.name: Web Traffic Analysis
techniques.blurb: Traffic trend, channel mix and engagement against competitors. Declining organic and rising paid is a diligence red flag.

techniques.name: Sentiment Analytics
techniques.blurb: NLP over reviews, app stores and Glassdoor for brand health, product-quality trend and employee sentiment as leading indicators.

phases.name: Financial diligence
phases.job: Transaction-level data, independently cut. The value is not reproducing management's analysis faster — it is producing the analysis management did not, and having it reconcile.

techniques.name: Revenue Decomposition
techniques.blurb: Price, volume, mix, customer flows, one-offs and FX from 75k invoice lines. Reported growth +18.6%; underlying −1.8%.

techniques.name: EBITDA Adjustments Validation
techniques.blurb: Rebuild management's pro forma adjustments bottom-up from transaction data and flag what does not reconcile.

techniques.name: Working Capital Analytics
techniques.blurb: Debtor and creditor days, inventory turns and cash conversion, with seasonality and period-end manipulation risk flagged.

techniques.name: SKU-Level Performance
techniques.blurb: Pareto and margin contribution across the range: what drives profit, what destroys it, and what the long tail really costs.

techniques.name: AI Document Review
techniques.blurb: LLM extraction of change-of-control clauses, renewal terms, pricing escalators and risk provisions from contracts and leases.

techniques.name: Repeatable Analysis Packs
techniques.blurb: Sector-specific templates that run on every deal — insurance loss triangles, software ARR and NRR, and a generic pack.

phases.name: SPA & completion
phases.job: The highest-stakes arithmetic on any deal, usually done under time pressure in spreadsheets nobody has time to check. Automation here is not efficiency — it is error reduction on numbers that settle the price.

techniques.name: Data Room Analytics
techniques.blurb: Nine weeks of bidder telemetry. Six names on the process letter, 3.0 expected live bids, and the SPA issues visible weeks before the first mark-up.

techniques.name: Balance Sheet Carve-Out
techniques.blurb: Segment an intermingled P&L from transaction data using explicit allocation bases, then drive the balance sheet off the segmented P&L and headcount.

techniques.name: SPA Automation
techniques.blurb: Net debt, completion working capital against the peg, and earnout mechanics built from source data rather than retyped.

techniques.name: Dispute Investigation
techniques.blurb: Forensic anomaly detection for revenue inflation, cut-off manipulation and channel stuffing after completion.

phases.name: Value creation
phases.job: The deal model becomes an operating plan. Most synergy programmes fail quietly for eighteen months before anyone says so — the job is making the gap visible at month nine.

techniques.name: Synergy Tracking
techniques.blurb: Realisation against the deal model at month 14 of 24, with conversion fitted on 260 prior initiatives. Forecast £13.8m against £24.5m — and the model is unreachable from the current pipeline.

techniques.name: Portfolio KPI Dashboards
techniques.blurb: Portfolio-company monitoring: financial and operational KPIs, covenant headroom with forward projection, automated RAG reporting.

techniques.name: Procurement & Spend
techniques.blurb: Spend cube across a merged supplier base: category consolidation, maverick spend, tail rationalisation and phased savings.

techniques.name: Raw Material Passthrough
techniques.blurb: Whether input cost moves reach customer pricing, how fast, and what the lag is costing in margin.

techniques.name: Segmentation & Cross-Sell
techniques.blurb: RFM segmentation of the combined base, propensity modelling, cross-sell sizing and overlap analysis.

techniques.name: SKU Harmonisation
techniques.blurb: Overlapping ranges across two merged portfolios, margin impact of rationalisation scenarios, optimal combined assortment.

techniques.name: Finance Close Effectiveness
techniques.blurb: Task-level duration tracking, bottleneck identification and an automation roadmap from a 20-day close to seven.

techniques.name: Tax Operations Automation
techniques.blurb: ERP extraction, automated calculation, filing timeline management and exception-based review.

crosscutting.name: AI & emerging technology
crosscutting.job: Not a phase — a capability layer. The constraint on AI in a deals environment is almost never the model; it is governance, data handling and whether anyone can audit what the thing did.

techniques.name: Agentic Deal Workflows
techniques.blurb: An agent running the repetitive diligence loop — IR tracking, document triage, Q&A prep, anomaly flagging — with a visible trace and human gates.

techniques.name: Text-to-SQL for Deal Teams
techniques.blurb: Natural-language querying over deal data with schema grounding, generated SQL shown for inspection and row-level audit logging.

techniques.name: LLM Governance
techniques.blurb: Data classification, prompt guardrails, client-name and PII redaction, output validation and audit trail. The actual blocker at most firms.

techniques.name: Computer Vision for Ops DD
techniques.blurb: Site condition assessment, safety compliance and asset scoring from visual data.

techniques.name: Voice-to-Text for Field Ops
techniques.blurb: Voice memo capture from field workers, entity extraction and structured output.
